tagline: A cloud-based platform powering property management and real estate operations
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the primary growth driver for AppFolio: each added unit generates recurring revenue through subscription services and value-added services, and reflects platform adoption within the real estate ecosystem. It is a structural indicator of market penetration and scalability.

kpis.name: Property Management Units
kpis.explanation: Total number of real estate units managed by clients on the AppFolio platform
kpis.description: Key indicator of penetration in the property management market. Up 8% from 8.7 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Solid 8% growth in 2025, despite a challenging real estate market

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from subscription services and value-added services
kpis.description: Total revenue of $950.8 million in 2025, up 20% from the prior year.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth, driven by unit expansion and value-added services

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from monthly or annual subscription fees for platform access
kpis.description: Subscription revenue of $211.5 million in 2025, up 17% from $180.6 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Recurring growth pillar, with strong customer retention

kpis.name: Value Added Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transactional services such as payments, tenant screening, and risk management
kpis.description: Value-added services revenue of $721.5 million in 2025, up 19% from $605.0 million in 2024. Represents 75.9% of total revenue.
kpis.signal: Strong transactional revenue growth, driven by adoption of electronic payments and screening services

kpis.name: Non-GAAP Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating margin, excluding non-recurring expenses such as stock-based compensation
kpis.description: 24.7% in 2025, down 0.5 points from 25.2% in 2024, reflecting growth investments.
kpis.signal: High margin for the software sector, despite slight contraction

kpis.name: GAAP Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating margin under U.S. generally accepted accounting principles
kpis.signal: Solid operating margin despite the impact of stock-based compensation

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of research and development expenses in total revenue
kpis.description: In 2025, R&D expenses represent 12.5% of revenue, slightly down from 13.3% in 2024.
kpis.signal: Sustained investment in innovation and AI integration via Realm

kpis.name: Net Cash from Operations
kpis.explanation: Cash generated from the company's core business activities
kpis.description: $242.1 million in 2025, compared to $188.2 million in 2024, or 25.5% of revenue. Annual growth of 28.6%.
kpis.signal: Significant improvement in cash generation, at 25.5% of revenue

kpis.name: Property Management Units
kpis.explanation: Total number of real estate units managed by clients on the AppFolio platform
kpis.description: 9.4 million in 2025, up 8% from 8.7 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Continued unit base growth, a driver of scalability

kpis.name: Value Added Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from transactional services such as payments, tenant screening, and risk management
kpis.description: 19% growth in 2025 to $721.5 million, driven by electronic payments and screening services.
kpis.signal: Acceleration in transactional revenue, indicating deeper adoption of value-added services

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from monthly or annual subscription fees for platform access
kpis.description: Subscription revenue up 17% in 2025 to $211.5 million, supported by new customer and unit additions.
kpis.signal: Stable recurring revenue growth, foundation of predictability

risks.title: Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: AppFolio is subject to various federal, state and local laws and regulations. Certain services such as tenant screening and risk mitigation are highly regulated. As electronic payments services evolve, the company may become directly subject to money transmission and anti-money laundering laws. Unfavorable interpretations or violations could result in litigation, governmental investigation, and increased operating costs.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: As a cloud-based platform handling critical customer data and financial information, AppFolio faces significant cybersecurity risks. Data breaches or cyberattacks could lead to financial losses, reputational damage, regulatory penalties, and loss of customer trust.

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: AppFolio operates in a competitive property management software market. Changes in competitive dynamics, new entrants, or competitive pricing could impact market share, customer acquisition costs, and revenue growth.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a technology company in the real estate sector, AppFolio faces potential litigation and regulatory actions related to its services, compliance violations, customer disputes, or intellectual property matters.

risks.title: Third-Party Service Provider Dependence
risks.score_rationale: AppFolio depends on third-party providers for key services including payment processing, credit reporting, and risk mitigation services. Disruptions or failures by these providers could impact service delivery and customer satisfaction.

ai_positioning.summary: AppFolio integrates artificial intelligence directly into its platform through Realm, which automates repetitive, high-volume tasks and enhances operational efficiency across the real estate management workflow.
evidence: AppFolio Realm integrates artificial intelligence directly into the platform's workflows
Platform is capable of automating repetitive, high-volume tasks and promoting operational efficiency
